article.title: Rappers for regime change: How the CIA recruits hip hop artists around the world
article.author: Alan MacLeod
article.content: Washington has spent tens of millions of dollars funding, training, and promoting artists who foment public discontent, organize protests, and lead color revolutions in nations in its crosshairs. The post Rappers for regime change: How the CIA recruits hip hop artists around the world appeared first on MR Online .
